text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it had assigned a "BBB-minus" corporate credit rating and "A3" short term rating to Fernz Corp Ltd of New Zealand.
The ratings agency said the outlook was stable.

"Ratings on Fernz reflect a moderate financial risk profile, solid positions in several chemical commodity markets, and a strong competitive position in its key regional fertilizer business," S&P said.
"A solid position in niche markets supports rating stability," the ratings agency said.

"Standard and Poor's anticipates the maintenance of a moderate financial profile, with capital programmes and modest-sized complementary acquisitions, financed largely through internal cash generation and some incremental debt usage," it said.
